name: DHL Supply Chain - Siemens Healthineers Life Sciences DC - Memphis TN

fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled truck entrance on the west side off Global Drive: a black metal cantilever sliding gate set in the property's ornamental perimeter fence (confirmed in Street View 2025-04). The entire ~24-acre parcel is fenced.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth at the gate. Street View shows only the sliding gate plus a control pedestal / card-reader on a yellow bollard — no staffed booth structure.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Truck gate present + no guard shack + a control pedestal at the gate = remote/kiosk/card-reader check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors on the building's west face; ~14 doors visible with box trucks and a trailer backed in. Band 10-25.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Only a few trailers/box trucks in the truck yard; no dedicated trailer-storage lot. Band 0-10.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Single dock bank on the west face — a 'RECEIVING' sign marks it; ship and receive run from the same dock cluster.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved truck yard inside the gate ahead of the docks gives room to hold trucks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Internal west-side truck yard can stack 3+ trucks between the gate and docks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Memphis southeast industrial submarket, dense logistics fabric = Urban.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~14 doors estimated from satellite z20 and Street View; band 10-25 confident, exact count approximate.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 422,000 sq ft building (Siemens Healthineers occupies ~260,000 sq ft) on a fenced parcel of ~24 acres.
